title: Use a snippet in a reply
blurb: Drop in a saved answer instead of typing the same thing again.

steps.title: Open the conversation
steps.body: Click the chat you want to reply to, and pick SMS or Email in the channel switcher.

steps.title: Open your snippets
steps.body: Click the **Snippets** icon in the reply box toolbar. Your saved text or email snippets appear.

steps.title: Pick one
steps.body: Search or scroll, then click the snippet. It drops into the reply box with the customer's name and other details already filled in.

steps.title: Tweak and send
steps.body: Adjust anything that needs a personal touch, then click send.
steps.tip: No snippets yet? See **Create a text snippet** in the Guide.
